practice_bank: Convert five broad topics into bounded research questions and justify feasibility.
Evaluate six mixed-quality sources using authority, evidence, method, currency and conflict-of-interest criteria.
Build and rerun a documented Boolean search strategy in two scholarly discovery environments.
Construct an evidence matrix from at least eight sources and identify agreement, disagreement and gaps.
Audit a draft for claim-to-source support, paraphrase integrity, quotation accuracy and bidirectional references.
Produce a reproducible mini-review package including search log, exclusions, synthesis and limitations.
Rewrite one message for academic, executive and public audiences and explain the rhetorical choices.
Build claim-reason-evidence-counterargument maps for three contested questions.
Reverse-outline a weak essay and repair its document architecture.
Create a synthesis matrix and integrate six sources by theme rather than author.
Transform a long narrative into an evidence-led decision memo.
Perform argument, paragraph and sentence revision passes and submit a change rationale.
Classify variables and document data-quality issues in a real open dataset.
Compare mean, median, spread and distribution shape under outlier scenarios.
Recalculate percentage-point, relative and absolute changes from public claims.
Use frequency tables to solve conditional-probability and base-rate problems.
Redesign misleading charts and explain each correction.
Build a reproducible spreadsheet analysis and two-page evidence brief from open data.
Design a recoverable file, versioning and backup system and test restoration.
Audit account permissions and create a least-privilege remediation list without exposing credentials.
Verify three online claims by tracing them to original evidence.
Work through phishing and account-compromise simulations and document first-response actions.
Audit a digital artifact for privacy, copyright, accessibility and open-license compliance.
Create and test a personal digital-resilience checklist covering security, recovery and wellbeing.
Classify AI use cases by task, consequence of error, reversibility and required oversight.
Compare multiple prompt/workflow designs and measure unsupported claims and instruction adherence.
Create a ten-case evaluation set with normal, difficult and edge cases for one AI task.
Audit AI-generated factual claims and citations against authoritative sources.
Threat-model an AI workflow that can access files or tools, including prompt-injection risks.
Design a responsible AI workflow with data boundaries, evaluation, approvals, logging, fallback and incident response.
Conduct problem interviews without pitching and code evidence of frequency, consequence and current workaround.
Map direct competitors, substitutes, internal alternatives and the status quo from the user's decision perspective.
Rank business-model assumptions by importance and evidence strength.
Design and run a falsifiable low-cost validation experiment with a predefined decision threshold.
Build base, upside and downside unit-economics and cash scenarios.
Create a stakeholder-risk register and a ninety-day venture/career execution plan.
